mentions.name: OmniUI
mentions.description: This is a Swift UI framework designed as a drop-in replacement for SwiftUI, enabling write-once-run-everywhere apps via pluggable renderer backends. TUI (notcurses) and Adwaita/GTK backends already work, and the author is choosing Adwaita for its opinionated design language. Apps avoid Apple-specific libraries (like Vision), and CoreData/SwiftData have been reimplemented to support running on Linux; the author's Gopher browser is the first target app. Unlike SwiftUI-inspired projects such as adwaita-swift and swift-cross-ui, the goal is to use the actual SwiftUI API everywhere rather than a lookalike.
mentions.problem: SwiftUI code is effectively limited to Apple platforms, preventing write-once-run-everywhere Swift apps.
mentions.source_excerpt: The idea is to create a drop-in replacement called OmniUI which will have different renderer backends (I currently have TUI w/ notcurses and Adwaita/GTK working)
